rules.draw: Every sim-day at 06:00 the engine draws from the deck: each card fires with probability weight/100 (independently), max 2 per day; cards with "kind": "everyday" are small village news drawn in their own slot (1-2 a day, a week apart, {name} filled with random villagers). 'once' cards are removed after firing. Cards can also be injected by the admin API.
rules.effects: Effects are applied by code (economy/state changes). 'broadcast' text becomes a memory for every NPC at the listed locations (or all NPCs if 'town'). 'targets' get the memory with importance 8+ and an immediate re-plan.

deck.title: Storm off the point
deck.text: A storm hits Solmere overnight. Boats stay in; the harbour road floods.

deck.title: The run comes in
deck.text: A huge shoal moves into the bay. Every net comes back full.

deck.title: Blight on the lower field
deck.text: Blight takes a third of the grain on the hill farms.

deck.title: Orchard glut
deck.text: The McBride orchard produces the best fruit in a decade.

deck.title: The 'Cormorant' docks
deck.text: A merchant ship docks for two days. Sailors with money fill the tavern, the inn, and the café.

deck.title: The regional inspector
deck.text: A regional inspector arrives unannounced to audit the town's books and the harbour.

deck.title: Tide Festival
deck.text: The Tide Festival is declared for the day after tomorrow. Music in the square, stalls, a bonfire on the beach.

deck.title: Fever in Salt Lane
deck.text: A fever goes through Salt Lane. The clinic queue runs out the door.

deck.title: Regional grain shortage
deck.text: Grain prices double across the region. Solmere's farms suddenly matter.

deck.title: Lost shipment
deck.text: The cloth and goods shipment is lost at sea. Nothing new on the shelves for a week.

deck.title: The regional lottery
deck.text: Someone in Solmere holds a winning regional lottery ticket worth 3,000 crowns.

deck.title: Engine trouble
deck.text: The 'Second Chance' loses its engine a mile out. Towed in by the 'Patience'.

deck.title: Break-in on Main Street
deck.text: Someone broke into a Main Street shop overnight. The till is empty.

deck.title: The chapel roof gives
deck.text: Part of the chapel roof collapses in the night. Nobody hurt. Repairs will cost 900 crowns.

deck.title: Anonymous envelope
deck.text: An envelope with 900 crowns and no note is left at the chapel.

deck.title: A petition circulates
deck.text: A petition for a rent cap is going around the square. It already has twenty names.

deck.title: Council seat opens
deck.text: A council seat is vacant. The mayor must appoint someone within three days.

deck.title: A letter from another port
deck.text: A letter arrives addressed to 'Marcus Halvorsen, Solmere'. The postman holds it.

deck.title: Fishers' meeting
deck.text: Chen Wei has called the fishers and porters to the docks after dark to 'talk about prices'.

deck.title: Open mic at the Anchor
deck.text: Jonah announces an open mic night. Rafa is hosting. Anyone can sing.

deck.title: Heatwave
deck.text: Three days of heat. The beach is full; the fields are hard work; tempers are short.

deck.title: Tax day
deck.text: Tax is due. The clerk posts the notice on the town hall door.

deck.title: Rumour of a wedding
deck.text: Sal says someone bought a ring at the general store. Nobody knows who.

effects.gossipSeed: someone in town bought a ring

deck.title: Regional health grant
deck.text: A regional grant of 2,500 crowns is available for the clinic — if the council matches 500.

deck.title: A boat nobody knew about
deck.text: At dawn, a small new boat is carried down from the Net Loft to the water.

deck.title: A birthday
deck.text: It is {name}'s birthday. Someone has left a cake on their doorstep with no note.

deck.title: The goat is loose
deck.text: Hamish's goat is loose on Main Street again and {name} is trying to catch it.

deck.title: A new recipe
deck.text: {name} is trying out a new recipe and wants everyone's opinion.

deck.title: A visiting cousin
deck.text: {name}'s cousin has arrived from the city for a few days, full of stories.

deck.title: Exam results
deck.text: The school's exam results are out; {name} is either very proud or very quiet.

deck.title: A leaking roof
deck.text: {name}'s roof leaked in the night. They need a carpenter and a dry corner.

deck.title: Football on the beach
deck.text: There is a football game on the beach this evening, fishers against farmers.

deck.title: An anniversary
deck.text: {name} and {name2} have been friends for thirty years today, and somebody remembered.

deck.title: A new baby
deck.text: A baby was born last night in Salt Lane. The whole street is talking about the name.

deck.title: A lost wallet
deck.text: {name} found a wallet on the quay and is looking for its owner.

deck.title: Lights out
deck.text: The power went out across town for an hour after dark. Candles came out.

deck.title: A stray dog
deck.text: A thin stray dog has been following {name} around all morning.

deck.title: Rain on the washing
deck.text: A sudden shower soaked everyone's washing. Salt Lane is laughing about it.

deck.title: An old letter
deck.text: {name} found an old letter from someone they loved, tucked in a book.

deck.title: Singing at the chapel
deck.text: The chapel choir is practising tonight and needs more voices.

deck.title: Market stalls
deck.text: Extra stalls are up in the square: honey, rope, second-hand books.

deck.title: A whale in the bay
deck.text: A whale was seen off the point at dawn. Half the town went to the beach to look.

deck.title: A twisted ankle
deck.text: {name} twisted an ankle on the harbour steps and is limping about.

deck.title: A prize marrow
deck.text: {name} has grown the biggest marrow anyone has seen and is showing it to everyone.

deck.title: A stranger at the inn
deck.text: A stranger with a sketchbook has taken a room at the inn and asks a lot of questions.

deck.title: Quiz night
deck.text: It is quiz night at the Anchor. Teams are forming and old rivalries with them.

deck.title: Fixing the bench
deck.text: {name} has decided to repaint the old bench in the square, unasked.

deck.title: Asking for advice
deck.text: {name} is quietly asking around for advice about a family matter.

deck.title: Bake sale
deck.text: The school is holding a bake sale for new books. Everyone is expected to bring something.

deck.title: Homesick
deck.text: {name} got a phone call from home and has been quiet since.

deck.title: A lesson
deck.text: {name} is teaching {name2} how to do something they've always wanted to learn.

deck.title: A fishing bet
deck.text: {name} and {name2} have a bet on who catches the biggest fish this week.

deck.title: A small gift
deck.text: {name} left a jar of something homemade on {name2}'s doorstep.

rent_cap.title: Cap weekly rents at 80% of current

liquor_licence_cafe.title: Grant Café Moreno an evening liquor licence

harbour_wall.title: Fund the harbour wall (6,000 crowns over 20 days)
